headline: skill marketplace for ai development
short_description: AI-assisted development marketplace for Claude Code. Operations teams can automate workflows, integrate with GitHub, and enhance productivity with pre-built skills.
author: aheritier

sections.overview:
Boost Your AI is a Claude Code skill marketplace that extends AI-assisted development capabilities with pre-built integrations. The jj-lsp skill delivers a lightweight Java language server running on Node.js, eliminating JVM overhead while providing essential code intelligence features like go-to-definition, find references, auto-completion, and diagnostics. It supports Maven, Gradle, Lombok, and Spring Boot projects, starting 9x faster and using 7.5x less memory than traditional Java LSP implementations. Developers can quickly add the marketplace to Claude Code and leverage these skills to enhance productivity in Java development workflows.
Navigate Java codebases with go-to-definition and find-references commands
Get auto-completion and semantic tokens for Java files in Claude Code
Format code and rename symbols across Maven and Gradle projects
Build Spring Boot applications with intelligent code actions
